judgment.label: incorrect
judgment.mode_quote: Best Buy's gross margins appear relatively consistent, fluctuating within a narrow range from year-to-year
judgment.reason: Evidence shows FY2023 revenue 46,298 and COGS 36,386 => gross margin 21.4%; FY2022 51,761 and 40,121 => 22.5%; FY2021 47,262 and 36,689 => 22.4%. Candidate claims FY2021 margin 22.4% (correct) but states range 21.3%-22.5% and 'fluctuated between 21.3% and 22.5%' with FY2023 21.4% down from 22.5%; evidence supports ~21.4/22.5/22.4, no 21.3%. Reference says minor 1.1% decline FY22-FY23; candidate says consistent within ~2% which matches reference direction but invents 21.3% low and misstates FY2021 as 22.4% up from 22.4% (same). Material margin figure error makes answer incorrect.
